text:
Gold Price in 1988
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1988, the LBMA gold price fell 10.4% between 1988-01-29 ($458) and 1988-12-29 ($410). The highest sampled price was $458 in January and the lowest was $397 in September. The mean of these observations was $432. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
